_comment: Builds, tool, map and template versions this merged tool's pieces were validated on (design: Supported builds, rule 4). The tool refuses other builds unless FORCE_BUILDS=1. The setup_status words are build vocabulary read by the replace gate.
source_min_note: decision of 2026-11-24: only the latest 4.14.x is a source. The manager, indexer and dashboard of every node must be this version or a newer 4.14.x (one published after the tool); older is refused (upgrade to the latest 4.14.x first), 4.15+ and 5.x are not a 4.14 source. Raise it when a newer 4.14.x is published and validated. 4.14.11 was published on 2026-11-25 (GA 15:19Z): 4.14.10 is no longer a source.

v4_assistant.note: That URL serves only the latest 4.14.x and no per-version URL is published (2026-11-25: four candidate forms answer 403). The tool reads the staged file's wazuh_version and refuses one that does not install the source's own version (pre-copy, 4.x removal, going back), naming the file to give.

target_5x_note: 5.0.0 release candidate and nightlies of 2026-11-22 to 2026-11-24; the nightly manifest hash changes daily and is recorded, not pinned
